guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - Suffolk
guard_streams.write_limit: Original and redesigned contract values are procurement scope and do not establish current selected-parcel orderability.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 1 July 2023.
The page was last updated on 26 May 2026.
The original contract covered around 79,500 premises.
The original contract value was £100.5 million.
The original contract was signed in June 2023.
CityFibre and BDUK redesigned the contract in May 2026.
The redesigned contract covers around 60,000 premises.
The redesigned investment is up to £118.2 million.
The redesign aims to minimise overlap with commercial rollout.
Residents and businesses can request service after the network has been built.
